data.gender_notes: Jackqueline is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Iacobus (Jacob) and Helena. Iacobus means 'supplanter' or 'he who follows', and Helena means 'shining light'. Jackqueline combines the meanings to signify 'God is gracious to one who supplants or follows'. The name Jackqueline carries the meaning “God is gracious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jackqueline usually hope their child will grow to embody god is gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jackqueline total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: ג'קקולין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ג'קקולין היא צורה נוצרית של השם היווני 'יואקים' (יוחאי), שמשמעותו 'ה' יוחאי' או 'אלוהים יוחס'. השם 'ג'קקולין' הוא צורה לטינית של השם, ואומץ על ידי הנוצרים. השם 'ג'קקולין' מסמל גבורה וצדק, והוא קשור לציווי 'בקשו את שלום' (ישעיהו 32:17).

in_greek.name: Γiacquin
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γiacquin είναι μια χριστιανική форма του ονόματος 'Ιωακείμ' (Ιωαχείμ), το οποίο σημαίνει 'Απόστραφος του Θεού' ή 'Θεός δίδυμος'. Το όνομα Γiacquin είναι μια λατινική μορφή του ονόματος, και αργότερα υιοθετήθηκε από τους χριστιανούς. Το όνομα Γiacquin συμβολίζει την ανδρεία και την δικαιοσύνη, και συνδέεται με την εντολή 'ζητήστε την ειρήνη' (Ισαιά 32:17).

in_latin.name: Jacqueline
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Jacqueline est forma christiana nominis 'Iacobi' (Iacobus), quod significat 'Abstulit Deum' vel 'Deus duplex'. Nomen Jacqueline est forma latina nominis, et postea adoptata a Christianis. Nomen Jacqueline designat virtutem et iustitiam, et connexus est cum mandato 'Petite pacem' (Isaiah 32:17).

in_english.name: Jackqueline
in_english.meaning: Queen, strong, and powerful, feminine and noble
in_english.long_meaning: Jackqueline is a Christian form of the name 'Jacqueline' (James), which means 'He who holds the key of David' or 'Son of thunder.' The name Jackqueline is a compound of the names Jack and Jacqueline, and it symbolizes strength, courage, and spiritual power. It is associated with the biblical reference 'Seek peace' (Isaiah 32:17).

Jackqueline has a charming, classic, and elegant sound, making it a popular name, although it is not commonly used outside of French-speaking communities.

Essentially, Jackqueline highlights the presence of guidance, grace, and the power of following one's spiritual path while navigating life's complexities.
